claims: As of April 13, 2026, Rory McIlroy has won six major championships.
Rory McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam by winning the 2025 Masters.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters Tournament in 2025.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters Tournament in 2026.
Rory McIlroy won the PGA Championship in 2012.
Rory McIlroy won the PGA Championship in 2014.
Rory McIlroy won The Open Championship in 2014.
Rory McIlroy won the U.S. Open in 2011.
Rory McIlroy is one of only six men to win all four modern major championships in their career.
Rory McIlroy was the youngest U.S. Open winner since 1923 when he won in 2011.
